channel.title: Conference Digest
channel.description: The talks and papers worth a networking, cloud, Kubernetes and AI PM's time, picked from each conference program and summarized by ToFaRev.

item.title: Open vSwitch and OVN 2026 Fall Conference
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Open vSwitch and OVN community conference on virtual networking, hardware offload, Kubernetes networking, and programmable infrastructure.

item.title: RIPE 93
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: A European operator meeting on Internet infrastructure, routing, DNS, peering, measurement, policy, and network automation.

item.title: @Scale: Product 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: Meta's AI-native product engineering conference on media, agents, product velocity, applied AI, and production reliability.

item.title: ARIN 58 Public Policy and Members Meeting
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: ARIN's public policy and members meeting on Internet number resources, registry operations, IPv6, routing security, and governance.

item.title: hack.lu 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: An open security conference organized by CIRCL, covering offensive and defensive security, privacy, identity, and Internet infrastructure.

item.title: LACNIC 46
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Latin American and Caribbean Internet registry meeting on routing, IPv6, DNS, peering, security, and regional policy.

item.title: NANOG 98
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The North American Network Operators' Group meeting on Internet operations, routing, interconnection, infrastructure, and automation.

item.title: PyTorch Conference 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The PyTorch community conference on machine-learning frameworks, distributed training, inference, production ML, and hardware acceleration.

item.title: SwiNOG #42
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Swiss network operators' meeting on Internet infrastructure, routing, peering, data centers, automation, and security.

item.title: ACM IMC 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: ACM's Internet measurement conference on network topology, performance, security, censorship, and Internet-wide analysis.

item.title: Capacity Europe 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: A carrier and digital-infrastructure conference on connectivity, fiber, subsea cables, data centers, AI infrastructure, and investment.

item.title: OCP Global Summit 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Open Compute Project summit on open data-center hardware, AI infrastructure, networking, storage, power, cooling, and security.

item.title: OPI Summit on DPUs/IPUs 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Open Programmable Infrastructure summit on DPU/IPU APIs, offload, cloud-native integration, and AI infrastructure.

item.title: Netnod Tech Meeting 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: Netnod's technical meeting on interconnection, Internet exchanges, routing security, DNS, timing, and network infrastructure.

item.title: AusNOG 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Australian network operators' conference on Internet infrastructure, peering, data centers, routing, automation, and security.

item.title: NLNOG Day 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Dutch network operators' meeting on routing, Internet infrastructure, automation, and operational practice.

item.title: @Scale: Networking 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: Meta's large-scale networking conference on AI fabrics, RDMA, data-center and backbone architecture, operations, and optical interconnects.

item.title: PETS 2026
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Privacy Enhancing Technologies Symposium on anonymity, privacy engineering, measurement, identity, and usable privacy.

item.title: IETF 126 (Vienna)
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: The Internet Engineering Task Force meeting for developing Internet standards across routing, transport, security, and applications.

item.title: Netdev 0x1A (Rome, 13-16 July 2026)
item.description: A technical conference on Linux kernel networking, including eBPF/XDP, packet processing, NIC offload, and transport internals.
